nodes.label: REVEAL Mechanisms
nodes.rationale: Current v12.1 research workflow selects an imported DisMech gap, retrieves EAGGL anchors, expands CFDE once and proposes inspectable DAPPER ScientificAccounts; the Next.js application and EC2 API/worker remain planned.

nodes.label: Selected DisMech KnowledgeGap
nodes.rationale: Search finds existing gaps; source text and linked DisMech context remain exact. User selection does not author a new Question or alter source assertions.

nodes.label: EAGGL mechanism anchors
nodes.rationale: Five suggestions total across linked mechanisms are editable, but analysis needs at least one resolved anchor. Retrieval similarity supplies candidates; source assertions supply scientific grounding.

nodes.label: Exact trait/factor-number EAGGL→CFDE crosswalk
nodes.rationale: The first application uses existing EAGGL vectors joined to the populated routing run: 1,756 mappings and 4,056 resolved GeneSet links. Labels and gene agreement are not prerequisites; routing is not biological equivalence.

nodes.label: Proposed 30-operation API contract
nodes.rationale: OpenAPI 3.1.1, contract 0.2.0-draft and design v12.1 specify a service that is not yet running. Examples and schema validation do not establish execution or scientific grounding.

nodes.label: Source-selected Composer
nodes.rationale: Composer accepts exact SelectedGap and editable EAGGL anchors; backend resolves linked DisMech context. Empty drafts are allowed, submitted jobs require a selected gap and 1–10 resolved cfde-inc-v2 anchors.

nodes.label: Shared analysis and paragraph jobs
nodes.rationale: Both job kinds share queued/running/cancel_requested/cancelled/succeeded/insufficient_evidence/failed states, durable attempts, sequenced events and cancellation. Browser closure does not cancel work.

nodes.label: Idempotent writes and optimistic draft versions
nodes.rationale: Bind caller, operation and canonical body to an Idempotency-Key for at least seven days; replay precedes version-conflict validation, preventing duplicate submission and paid attempts.

nodes.label: Transactional Paragraph outbox
nodes.rationale: Each accepted account commits with an automatic Paragraph outbox item. Analysis success is independent of paragraph success; explicit paragraph jobs permit retries without new research.

nodes.label: Bounded authorized provenance traversal
nodes.rationale: Resolvers cap upstream traversal at depth five and 250 nodes, preserve exact payload observations, report missing/partial coverage and never disclose unauthorized identifiers. A File location is not automatically a downloadable artifact.

nodes.label: EvidencePackage representation boundary
nodes.rationale: Canonical LinkML-generated Package components preserve prefix-aware DAPPER forms; REST Dapper components use compact IDs. They represent the same pinned scientific model rather than separate ontologies.

nodes.label: GET /v1/me (getMe)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Resolve a trusted registered or anonymous gateway assertion to a stable application UUID. No bearer means no private workspace access. Session cookies and OAuth routes belong to the gateway contract.

nodes.label: GET /v1/drafts (listDrafts)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Only drafts owned by the caller, ordered by updated_at descending then ID.

nodes.label: POST /v1/drafts (createDraft)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Create editable selection state. Empty body creates a null source gap, empty anchors/dismissals, cfde-inc-v2 and both initial KGs. A selected gap is resolved from exact source identity/revision. No client question or linked DisMech list is accepted. Saving does not collect evidence or run an agent.

nodes.label: GET /v1/drafts/{draft_id} (getDraft)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Returns only the server-confirmed version; local pending edits are not implied.

nodes.label: PATCH /v1/drafts/{draft_id} (updateDraft)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Replace composer using expected_version. The server increments the version only on commit. Stale revisions return 409 with current_version. Server derives ownership; unknown owner/provenance fields are rejected.

nodes.label: GET /v1/research-requests (listResearchRequests)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Immutable request snapshots owned by the caller, ordered by submitted_at descending then ID. Questions are DAPPER content; request records preserve submission and selection context.

nodes.label: GET /v1/research-requests/{request_id} (getResearchRequest)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Returns the exact saved composer, DAPPER inquiry, actor snapshot and originating draft revision.

nodes.label: GET /v1/knowledge-gaps/search (searchKnowledgeGaps)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Fuzzy lookup of imported DisMech gaps by default. Query text is not an authored inquiry or permission to launch research. Other explicit modes require their configured index and return 503 if unavailable. Rankings are retrieval signals. Example uses the exact CAD gap from the HTML study.

nodes.label: GET /v1/knowledge-gaps (listKnowledgeGaps)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Browse imported DisMech gaps. Initial homepage is curated, with exact public-account counts as of the returned timestamp. Counts never include private work. Default source=dismech, include both gap kinds and all original statuses; filters may narrow. No manufactured popularity ranking.

nodes.label: GET /v1/knowledge-gaps/{gap_id} (getKnowledgeGap)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Exact DAPPER KnowledgeGap plus one pinned source observation and attachment resolutions. source_revision selects a historical mapping; omission selects the latest accessible observation of this same digest. It never redirects to a different digest.

nodes.label: GET /v1/mechanisms/search (searchMechanisms)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Search mechanisms independently of gap lookup. Initial EAGGL retrieval uses existing label embeddings joined to the configured completed exact-trait/factor-number CFDE mapping run. Return selectable mapped records with DAPPER Mechanism, catalog File and native cfde-inc-v2 anchor; exclude unmatched source factors from selectable results. Label/gene agreement is not required. Retain source-hit, embedding and mapping provenance server-side; a full new CFDE embedding corpus is not a prerequisite.

nodes.label: GET /v1/mechanisms/{source_id} (getMechanism)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: URL-encode the entire opaque source ID, including slashes, hashes and colons. The required source_revision prevents draft restoration from silently using changed source content.

nodes.label: POST /v1/mechanisms/suggest (suggestMechanisms)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Resolve linked DisMech context server-side from source_gap. Search existing EAGGL label embeddings and join the configured completed exact-trait/factor-number CFDE crosswalk before the top-five cutoff. Rank mapped factors by maximum per-mechanism cosine, deduplicate full native identity, stable ID tie-break, at most five total excluding manual anchors and dismissals. Return fewer if needed; no silent refill on removal. With no linked mechanisms use the exact gap text/subquery and require user anchor selection. Ignore label/gene differences for routing; pin mapping/source/embedding runs in server-owned selection provenance.

nodes.label: GET /v1/jobs (listJobs)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: One job namespace for both kinds, ordered by created_at descending then ID. Only caller-owned or explicitly authorized jobs are visible.

nodes.label: POST /v1/jobs (createJob)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Replaces analysis-runs and account-specific paragraph-run creation. kind=analysis freezes draft/version, creates a research request and enqueues atomically. kind=paragraph uses an already saved account. Trusted backend supplies attribution, model/harness configuration and dates. Paid execution is asynchronous; 202 does not imply a successful scientific result. Idempotent replay returns the original job and never starts another paid attempt. Analysis submission requires an exact imported DisMech gap and nonempty resolved CFDE anchors. Freeze the saved source/mapping-run bindings and native IDs with the request; later mapping imports do not retarget historical jobs. Label/gene disagreement does not reject a mapped anchor. Persist each accepted account with an outbox record that automatically schedules its default paragraph job, unique by account payload, citation pins and paragraph settings. Analysis completion does not wait for paragraph success. Manual paragraph jobs support retries or alternate focus/settings.

nodes.label: GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} (getJob)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: The same endpoint monitors either job kind. Polling remains available after the event stream ends. Terminal states are succeeded, insufficient_evidence, failed and cancelled. A CFDE-empty result is insufficient_evidence; an unavailable required service is a failure, not evidence of biological absence.

nodes.label: GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/events (getJobEvents)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Accept application/json for a replayable event page, or text/event-stream for SSE. JSON supports after; SSE resumes with Last-Event-ID. If both are supplied they must agree. Events are per-job monotonic decimal IDs; delivery can repeat after reconnect, so deduplicate by job_id/id. SSE data is JobEvent JSON; colon-prefixed heartbeat comments are not events. Authenticate every reconnect. If history is no longer retained, return 409 EVENT_CURSOR_EXPIRED and recover with GET /jobs/{id}. Browser native EventSource cannot set a bearer header: use the authenticated Next.js proxy or fetch streaming.

nodes.label: POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/cancel (cancelJob)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: No request body. Repeated calls are idempotent. Returns the durable current job; a running job normally becomes cancel_requested. Cancellation is best effort until the worker records cancelled. An already terminal job returns unchanged, including a result committed before cancellation. Browser disconnect alone never cancels a job.

nodes.label: GET /v1/accounts/{dapper_id} (getAccount)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Returns exact DAPPER records, schema pin, payload checksums and provenance document. Scientific IDs never redirect to a newer revision. Select payload_sha256 to recover an exact historical observation; otherwise the server returns its designated current observation and checksum. Unhashable locator changes can share a scientific ID. Access is enforced independently of citation metadata. Upstream closure follows scientific references and provenance inputs only, max_depth 0..5 and max_nodes 1..250 (default 5/250). An opaque cursor continues the same owner/filter/payload observation; missing or bounded references are reported explicitly. Unauthorized references are omitted without revealing private identifiers.

nodes.label: GET /v1/claims/{dapper_id} (getClaim)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Returns exact DAPPER records, schema pin, payload checksums and provenance document. Scientific IDs never redirect to a newer revision. Select payload_sha256 to recover an exact historical observation; otherwise the server returns its designated current observation and checksum. Unhashable locator changes can share a scientific ID. Access is enforced independently of citation metadata. Upstream closure follows scientific references and provenance inputs only, max_depth 0..5 and max_nodes 1..250 (default 5/250). An opaque cursor continues the same owner/filter/payload observation; missing or bounded references are reported explicitly. Unauthorized references are omitted without revealing private identifiers.

nodes.label: GET /v1/gene-sets/{dapper_id} (getGeneSet)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Returns exact DAPPER records, schema pin, payload checksums and provenance document. Scientific IDs never redirect to a newer revision. Select payload_sha256 to recover an exact historical observation; otherwise the server returns its designated current observation and checksum. Unhashable locator changes can share a scientific ID. Access is enforced independently of citation metadata.

nodes.label: GET /v1/paragraphs/{dapper_id} (getParagraph)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Returns exact DAPPER records, schema pin, payload checksums and provenance document. Scientific IDs never redirect to a newer revision. Select payload_sha256 to recover an exact historical observation; otherwise the server returns its designated current observation and checksum. Unhashable locator changes can share a scientific ID. Access is enforced independently of citation metadata.

nodes.label: GET /v1/objects/{dapper_id} (resolveDapperObject)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Generic durable resolver for Questions, KnowledgeGaps, evidence, files and other schema-supported records. This supplies citation object_payload_ref resolution. DAPPER identity does not imply public access. Returns no other user's private provenance. Upstream closure follows scientific references and provenance inputs only, max_depth 0..5 and max_nodes 1..250 (default 5/250). An opaque cursor continues the same owner/filter/payload observation; missing or bounded references are reported explicitly. Unauthorized references are omitted without revealing private identifiers.

nodes.label: GET /v1/citations/{dapper_id} (getCitation)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: format controls the representation: native (default) application/json; csl-json application/vnd.citationstyles.csl+json; bibtex application/x-bibtex; biblatex application/x-biblatex; apa/mla text/plain. Incompatible Accept returns 406. revision pins exact metadata; omission selects latest accessible metadata for this exact scientific ID. Paragraph consumers MUST supply the pinned revision. Claims, Questions and KnowledgeGaps only. Unknown authors/dates stay unknown; no DOI is emitted without registration. APA/MLA examples illustrate the interface, not a tested renderer.

nodes.label: POST /v1/citations/render (renderCitations)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Format the saved paragraph's occurrences together for consistent numbering and author/year disambiguation. Exact metadata revisions and current permissions are required. Rendering is deterministic for pinned inputs/configuration and may be cached; it does not modify scientific IDs or launch an agent. Style/processor selection is deployment configuration, captured in the rendering manifest.

nodes.label: GET /v1/accounts (listAccounts)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Owner-scoped, newest first then account ID; deduplicate repeated deliveries by digest. Filter by exact gap_id. No private records from other users with the same gap. Closing remarks provide the summary; paragraph status is independent.

nodes.label: GET /v1/me/explorations (listExplorations)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Owner-scoped exact gap/source-revision projection, most recently explored first then source ID. Contains visits before a job is submitted. Resume through draft_id; account counts include only accessible owned results.

nodes.label: POST /v1/me/explorations (recordExploration)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Upsert one owner + exact source-gap/revision visit. Before session establishment browsing stays local; replay selected visits after trusted bootstrap. Owner is derived from the assertion. Does not create a scientific record or paid job.

nodes.label: GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/evidence-package (getEvidencePackage)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Owner-authorized analysis-job package. Return 409 EVIDENCE_PACKAGE_NOT_READY before freeze, 404 for unavailable/non-analysis jobs. Exact package hash and LinkML schema are independent of later tool ledger/output. Recorded source paths are not public download URLs. The example is a real bounded capture; the account example is separately authored and not a validated output of this capture.

nodes.label: GET /v1/paragraphs/{dapper_id}/export (exportParagraph)
nodes.rationale: Proposed API operation: Return content and download metadata in JSON. Markdown includes linked references; rich-text returns sanitized clipboard HTML plus plain text; LaTeX uses cite commands and references.bib. BibTeX contains every distinct exact target/revision cited by the paragraph. These numbered-reference exports do not claim APA/MLA styling. Fixture links are local-preview URLs; runtime must render authorized canonical resolver URLs.

nodes.label: Gap → anchors → draft → analysis → account → paragraph flow
nodes.rationale: Ten numbered stages separate interactive REST operations from asynchronous CFDE/Claude Code workers. Paragraph fan-out follows accepted accounts, and terminal failure or insufficiency preserves diagnostics.

nodes.label: Captured EvidencePackage 0.2-draft
nodes.rationale: Immutable, bounded captured input with source artifacts, DisMech gap and selected native CADinT2D Factor1. Coverage records 17 captured/retained nodes and 16 edges. Complete input capture is not worker dispatch authorization.

nodes.label: CAD PGS×context reverse-causation gap
nodes.rationale: Selected gap asks whether contexts amplify genetic risk or are downstream readouts. DAPPER identity is dapper:KnowledgeGap.zNV20nhHamt-a4CeAktQQPoAivOJe6xk; the authoring contract requires this exact gap.

nodes.label: CADinT2D cfde-inc-v2 Factor1
nodes.rationale: Native anchor factor:portal:CADinT2D:cfde-inc-v2:Factor1 preserves the source fit and trait. It is a DAPPER Mechanism; native identity is retained for upstream requests.

nodes.label: Explicit input capture and coverage
nodes.rationale: BioIndex responses are capped at eight rows and marked non-exhaustive. Factor/trait connection queries are empty; gene/gene_set results reach limits. Upstream build agreement remains unverified and upstream total unknown.

nodes.label: Dispatch readiness gates
nodes.rationale: input_capture_complete=true but agent_dispatch_validated=false; runtime/trusted attribution, target-model token budget, worker authorization and tool policy still require validation.

nodes.label: Unqueried selected external evidence
nodes.rationale: BiomarkerKG and ProKN are selected but assertions and ledger are empty with status not_queried; selection or schema discovery is not evidence of a retrieved assertion.

nodes.label: Authored CAD-in-T2D research statement fixture
nodes.rationale: Unpublished authored Paragraph dapper:Paragraph.uSYa1LdXNPuwlSgsCz3oZ7IfrVoztroD expresses ScientificAccount vp5Cf6LUg2TEzZLLzwLnQWiT9HtnMshd; 13 exact targets pin citation metadata revision 1.

nodes.label: Captured PIGEAN/EAGGL assessment examples
nodes.rationale: The design example interprets captured SHH/GLI3/TCF7L2 gene loadings and AMP AD/GTEx/PsychENCODE gene-set associations as mechanistic leads. Source loadings and trait scores remain method-specific and do not resolve causal direction.

nodes.label: Illustrative KG membership assertions
nodes.rationale: SHH-to-AMP AD/GTEx and TCF7L2-to-PsychENCODE membership are explicitly mock and unverified, not retrieved biological findings. Preserve this distinction in every graph use.

nodes.label: reveal-paragraph terminal profile
nodes.rationale: A saved Paragraph consumes its account and is the sole terminal object; one generated-by Activity is mandatory. Missing activity inputs are warnings. Pinned upstream DAPPER files remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Current question-first and reading-first UI
nodes.rationale: September 25 visual system uses white background, native sans-serif, neutral ink and blue controls, a 960px outer account column and 80-character reading measures. Keep question visible, prioritize closing remarks and expose evidence on demand; earlier green/serif iteration is historical.

nodes.label: Standalone HTML simulation
nodes.rationale: Frozen source data drives local search, identity choices, job playback, account inspection and workspace history. The result can be an explicitly unrelated reference account; no OAuth, API or Box run occurs.

nodes.label: Separate HuBMAP provenance study
nodes.rationale: Corrected 358-set collection, 964-gene union and 79 edges demonstrate GMT and processing provenance separately from the CAD account. A convenient unrelated collection must never be attached as account evidence.

nodes.label: Historical UI contract amendments
nodes.rationale: This file preserves amendment rationale from earlier versions. The v12 audit says the current OpenAPI now encodes selected-gap, anonymous identity, typed events, bounded traversal, listings and export changes; old "wire amendment required" wording is historical.

nodes.label: Source-owned mechanism links
nodes.rationale: Backend derives immutable linked DisMech context from the selected source revision; clients edit only EAGGL anchors. Possible genetic mechanisms are investigative leads, not validated causation.

nodes.label: Observable public agent transcript
nodes.rationale: Show ordered sanitized public message/tool arguments/results with call IDs and completion/error state. Proposed HTML tool names are fixtures, not verified MCP schemas; no private reasoning or invented measurements.

nodes.label: canSubmit
nodes.rationale: Requires a selected gap, exact unchanged gap text and at least one anchor before preview submission.

nodes.label: selectGap
nodes.rationale: Fixes the source gap text, resolves pathophysiology attachments and initializes illustrative anchors in client state.

nodes.label: fuzzyGapMatches
nodes.rationale: Local token, prefix and edit-distance matching over frozen gap text/scope/rationale; this is a prototype lookup, not semantic embeddings.

nodes.label: previewJobEvents
nodes.rationale: Builds ordered simulated preparation and tool events from captured fixture counts. Returns simulated=true; no tool is executed.

nodes.label: referenceGraphCounts
nodes.rationale: Uses frozen account-view graph counts for presentation, not measurements of the selected-gap expansion.

nodes.label: startJob
nodes.rationale: Guards with canSubmit, creates previewJobEvents and schedules local playback; no production job is submitted.

nodes.label: citationModel
nodes.rationale: Resolves each Paragraph target and exact metadata revision from the embedded registry; fails on a missing pin and numbers the complete set.

nodes.label: citedParagraphText
nodes.rationale: Slices Unicode code points with Array.from and adds citation markers to rendered HTML without changing stored Paragraph text.

nodes.label: persistWorkspace
nodes.rationale: Caches design history in sessionStorage and simulated registered profiles in localStorage; these IDs are not credentials.

nodes.label: chooseWorkspaceIdentity
nodes.rationale: Merges browser-local preview histories by simulated provider, sets preview state and persists it; no OAuth identity is proved.

nodes.label: mergeHistory
nodes.rationale: Deduplicates preview history by object ID, sorts by timestamp and retains at most 100 records.

nodes.label: rememberAccount
nodes.rationale: Records the example account only against its exact CAD gap, preserving the gap relationship when playback began from another gap.

nodes.label: Planned Claude Code in Upstash Box
nodes.rationale: An EC2 worker provisions Claude Code with separately configured model/harness pins and remote HTTP MCP. Account skill/bootstrap/linter exist, but Box provisioning, read-only mounts, full tool capture and live policy enforcement remain pending.

nodes.label: Observed Proto-OKN MCP development service
nodes.rationale: September 24 inventory observed mcp-okn 1.27.2 with 23 tools and successful selected-schema discovery. Development endpoint authentication behavior is an observation, not a production guarantee.

nodes.label: BiomarkerKG / BiomarkerKB KG
nodes.rationale: Selected graph biomarkerkg at https://purl.org/okn/frink/kg/biomarkerkg exposes literature-linked biomarker and disease schema. No scientific assertion query was run in the inventory.

nodes.label: ProKN / Protein Knowledge Network
nodes.rationale: Selected graph prokn at https://purl.org/okn/frink/kg/prokn exposes genes, proteins, pathways, diseases and reified statements. Schema discovery alone supports no mined claim.

nodes.label: Complete selected-KG evidence ledger
nodes.rationale: Capture every attempted request and full result/error, including empty/exploratory calls omitted by upstream transcript logging. A scoped adapter/proxy must enforce selected graphs, query types and budgets; onToolUse inputs alone do not prove complete output capture.

nodes.label: Explicit source entity crosswalk
nodes.rationale: Resolve source identifiers with evidence, species/context and mapping revisions. Text similarity does not establish entity identity and association does not imply causation.

nodes.label: Proposed worker-owned agent output manifest
nodes.rationale: reveal.agent-output/1 binds attempt, package/runtime/ledger hashes and accepted account files. Agent cannot self-certify acceptance, owner or timestamps; no result collector yet produces this transport.

nodes.label: Trusted worker acceptance boundary
nodes.rationale: Capture output bytes, assemble trusted source/actor/runtime records, mint, run final shared linter and separate exact-source, selected-KG, ownership and grounding gates. Only then commit scientific payloads, permissions, registry and Paragraph outbox.

nodes.label: One complete account per provenance document
nodes.rationale: Agent may propose up to three files, each containing exactly one ScientificAccount and all referenced dependencies. This matches DAPPER terminal constraints; identical shared scientific IDs can be reused across documents.

nodes.label: Insufficient evidence outcome
nodes.rationale: Insufficient evidence means no accepted accounts with recorded coverage explanation. Tool-policy violations, exceptions and invalid outputs are failures rather than biological conclusions.

nodes.label: Historical September 15 CFDE BioIndex recipes
nodes.rationale: BioIndex uses cfde-inc-v2 via positional gene_set_size keys. OpenAPI transport and index catalog must be read together; this service is no longer the primary graph backend, but remains a source for detailed observations.

nodes.label: Model-scoped factor identity
nodes.rationale: Factor identity is model, exact query phenotype and factor. Preserve the observed case-only phenotype anomaly rather than normalizing aliases; scores remain method-specific associations.

nodes.label: BioIndex continuation and byte-progress completeness
nodes.rationale: limit caps total results rather than normal page size; null continuation can still hide unread bytes. Full capture omits limit and validates final bytes_read=bytes_total, repeated tokens and restricted coverage.

nodes.label: Historical BioIndex membership limitation
nodes.rationale: September 15 membership catalogs advertised only cfde; cfde-inc-v2 queries returned zero. This does not imply absent biological membership. September 24 interactive API separately returns membership edges for cfde-inc-v2.

nodes.label: Planned registered and anonymous sessions
nodes.rationale: Submit-time ORCID, Google or anonymous continuation preserves the draft. Registered Auth.js uses encrypted JWT cookies without a DB adapter; anonymous workspace continuity is a separate trusted first-party session.

nodes.label: Portable application user UUID
nodes.rationale: Stable app_users UUID owns drafts/requests independently of provider credentials and DAPPER Person digests. login_identities uniquely maps verified issuer+subject. This permits auth replacement without rewriting scientific objects or ownership.

nodes.label: GatewayAssertion trust boundary
nodes.rationale: Next.js validates browser sessions and signs separate short-lived API JWT assertions. EC2 independently validates trust and ownership; provider tokens, Auth.js cookies and browser-supplied owner IDs are not API credentials.

nodes.label: Anonymous upgrade and explicit account claim
nodes.rationale: New verified login upgrades the same UUID; an existing-account transfer requires both current anonymous-session proof and fresh identity plus explicit transfer consent. Historical anonymous actors/bylines remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Versioned draft autosave
nodes.rationale: After trusted session creation, serialized debounced saves use expected_version and idempotency. Submission freezes the confirmed draft and actor transactionally; later editing cannot change the immutable request.

nodes.label: ORCID and Google identity providers
nodes.rationale: Google built-in OIDC supplies stable subject but no ORCID; custom ORCID OIDC supplies an authenticated ORCID with nullable email/name. Names or email matches never merge identities.

nodes.label: Versioned external citation registry
nodes.rationale: Citation records key exact Claim/Question/KnowledgeGap digests plus metadata_revision, ordered credits and supported first-mint/issue dates. Registry storage/resolvers/exporters remain application work; a DAPPER digest is not a registered DOI.

nodes.label: Acyclic citation identity
nodes.rationale: Mint the scientific object first and register metadata outside its hashable payload. has_recommended_citation is hashable and must not point back to this external registry; Claim.asserted_in is a publication back-reference.

nodes.label: Pinned Unicode CitationOccurrence spans
nodes.rationale: Paragraph citations contain exact target_id, positive metadata revision and zero-based inclusive/exclusive Unicode code-point spans. Missing revisions fail; correcting registry metadata alone does not rewrite a saved Paragraph.

nodes.label: Pinned whole-document CSL rendering
nodes.rationale: Generate BibTeX and CSL-JSON directly from authoritative metadata; format the full citation set together for consistent numbering/disambiguation, pinning processor/style/locale. API APA/MLA shapes are not measured renderer output.

nodes.label: Ordered human and AI attribution
nodes.rationale: Keep original source authors, human operator/publisher and literal software generator credits separate. Authenticated login does not confer source authorship; later profile/ownership changes do not rewrite historical bylines.

nodes.label: DAPPER scientific model integration
nodes.rationale: Historical v8 snapshot audit passed 287 targeted upstream tests and sampled 82 imported GeneSets for identity/schema compatibility; it was not a full application test. New agent starts use locked 0.2.0-a1 while original import pins and payloads remain unchanged.

nodes.label: ScientificAccount construction invariant
nodes.rationale: Each account frames the exact selected DisMech KnowledgeGap, ordered scoped Claims and nonempty closing_remarks. Findings/conclusions need CFDE ancestry; conclusions must be represented by Claims rather than new unsupported closing prose.

nodes.label: Target-specific EvidenceItems and shared sources
nodes.rationale: EvidenceItems interpret source Files or optional source Claims for a specific target Proposition with direction and explanation. Reuse sources across targets with separate EvidenceItems; a loading or rank is not a probability.

nodes.label: Separate scientific grounding and paragraph faithfulness
nodes.rationale: Schema, digest and linter checks establish structure and provenance, not whether source assertions support the prose. Final acceptance checks exact metrics, authorized locators and scientific scope; paragraph generation cannot introduce new research.

nodes.label: Immutable payload observations and provenance documents
nodes.rationale: One DAPPER digest may allow multiple verified payloads when unhashable fields change. Retain snapshots by object ID plus payload checksum and full provenance edges/documents; a node digest does not hash the whole graph.

nodes.label: Stable semantic gap projection
nodes.rationale: Map source gap content/kind/entity context to DAPPER while raw status, retrieval time and source refresh remain provenance observations. Status-only changes should not remint gaps; source scientific changes legitimately may.

nodes.label: Locked DAPPER 0.2.0-a1 runtime
nodes.rationale: Implemented bootstrap clones a reviewed locked release and runs a shared scientific-account linter. It explicitly accepts historical v8 inputs; remaining Box provision and trusted worker gates are not implemented.

nodes.label: Local source snapshots
nodes.rationale: September 15/24 local exports contain 18,419 factors, 19,959 mechanism occurrences, 3,367 gaps and 801,934 GeneSets. Mechanism occurrence counts are not counts of biologically distinct mechanisms; source assertions are preserved rather than revalidated.

nodes.label: DisMech browser/YAML count reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Older public static browser has 149 discussions and 127 KNOWLEDGE_GAP entries, while local YAML has 4,051 discussions including groupings and 2,604 KNOWLEDGE_GAP plus 763 HUMAN_MODEL_MISMATCH. These differ in source date/scope, not extraction arithmetic.

nodes.label: Explicit DisMech attachment resolution
nodes.rationale: 6,422 references comprise 6,329 resolved, 79 whole-section, four whole-document and ten ambiguous targets. Ambiguities remain explicit and must not become automatically selected seeds.

nodes.label: Imported CFDE GeneSet catalog
nodes.rationale: 801,934 GeneSets and aliases establish catalog/encoding provenance only; members and original scientific construction history are not loaded. Original dependency snapshot and digests remain authoritative.

nodes.label: Aurora MySQL current data foundation
nodes.rationale: September 25 v12.1 verification records 14 applied inventory/routing tables and nine prepared but unapplied DisMech tables. Application user/job/citation/general provenance storage remains proposed; MySQL owns durable records.

nodes.label: Existing BioBERT vectors and exact cosine search
nodes.rationale: 3,103 live 768-dimensional legacy EAGGL label vectors use the selected BioBERT model. Join completed CFDE routing before ranking; embed DisMech query text on demand using the same configuration. Native Aurora vector support has not been verified.

nodes.label: Proposed application persistence
nodes.rationale: Add stable users/login mappings, versioned drafts, immutable requests, job leases/events, evidence ledger, payload/provenance snapshots, access grants and append-only citations. Commit accepted scientific results transactionally; digest deduplication grants no access.

nodes.label: Current v12.1 consolidation audit
nodes.rationale: The audit distinguishes implementation contracts, component tests and captured fixtures from a deployed end-to-end system. Its original 11-table snapshot predates the later crosswalk load; current state is 14 applied plus nine pending Prisma models.

nodes.label: Distinct valid Mechanism projection revisions
nodes.rationale: Earlier CAD account and current collector describe the same native Factor1 using different hashable names/descriptions and therefore different valid digests. Preserve the historical account; production selection/storage/package assembly must share the collector-compatible adapter.

nodes.label: Superseded design history
nodes.rationale: Earlier free-text entry, graph-path evidence proposal, registered-only submission and analysis-runs naming are historical. Current workflow accepts selected gaps, anonymous principals and shared jobs; do not implement withdrawn drafts.

nodes.label: Historical AgentRunner and PostgreSQL proposal
nodes.rationale: Initial proposal used a provider-independent sandbox AgentRunner, PostgreSQL/pgvector, provisional DAPPER claims and Proto-OKN grounding. The consolidated plan supersedes these defaults.

nodes.label: Historical v2 ScientificAccount workflow
nodes.rationale: Replaced flat claims with organized ScientificAccounts, Aurora MySQL, one expansion round and Upstash Box. Paragraph authoring was then a separate user-triggered action.

nodes.label: Historical v3 required EAGGL anchors
nodes.rationale: DisMech provides context while at least one selected EAGGL factor anchors CFDE; five semantic defaults and Claude Code in Box were settled.

nodes.label: Historical v4 DAPPER GeneSet aliases
nodes.rationale: Introduced loaded GeneSet identities with versioned CFDE aliases and a frozen DAPPER schema including Question/KnowledgeGap.

nodes.label: Historical v5 scholarly object citations
nodes.rationale: Claims, Questions and KnowledgeGaps became individually citable with versioned metadata; a digest is not a registered DOI.

nodes.label: Historical v6 NextAuth JWT authentication
nodes.rationale: Proposed ORCID/Google JWT sessions without a database adapter and a trusted EC2 identity assertion. This version still required registered authentication before jobs.

nodes.label: Historical v7 portable ownership and autosave
nodes.rationale: Application-owned immutable user IDs separate ownership from the auth framework. Versioned signed-in drafts and frozen request history preserve continuity.

nodes.label: Historical v8 implemented DAPPER contract
nodes.rationale: Question/KnowledgeGap, structured Paragraph citations and citation metadata validators were audited as implemented upstream; source adapters, assembly and persistence remained REVEAL work.

nodes.label: Historical v9 OpenAPI and shared jobs contract
nodes.rationale: OpenAPI 3.1.1 added common analysis/paragraph jobs, manual mechanism search, request detail and a generic DAPPER resolver; scientific classes stayed pinned to the v8 audit.

nodes.label: Historical v10 anonymous workspaces
nodes.rationale: Submit-time anonymous continuation joined ORCID/Google with durable application ownership and later verified upgrade rules; HTML remained a simulation.

nodes.label: Historical v11 DisMech-gap-only discovery
nodes.rationale: Search text retrieves existing gaps and never creates a scientific Question. Selected source question and linked DisMech context stay fixed while users edit EAGGL anchors.

nodes.label: Historical v11 personal gap/account workspace
nodes.rationale: Always-available avatar opens two dashboard tabs: knowledge gaps and scientific accounts. Prototype local storage does not constitute production ownership.

nodes.label: Contract authority and precedence
nodes.rationale: Current plan owns product behavior; OpenAPI owns public wire shapes; evidence LinkML owns input shape; pinned DAPPER owns scientific identity. Resolve conflicts in contracts before implementation.

nodes.label: DisMech KnowledgeGap selection
nodes.rationale: Free text is a lookup query. Preserve imported gap text and revision; curated mechanisms are read-only source context.

nodes.label: Initial crosswalk-backed retrieval
nodes.rationale: Search existing BioBERT label vectors and join completed exact trait/factor mappings before the top-five cutoff. Full current-model re-embedding and biological agreement are not prerequisites.

nodes.label: Frozen-seed one-round CFDE expansion
nodes.rationale: Four direct expansions use one frozen seed set, followed by contextual edges. Returned factors never become new seeds.

nodes.label: Next.js / FastAPI / EC2 / Aurora architecture
nodes.rationale: Independent browser frontend, REST API and worker use Aurora as system of record; components exist but the integrated services remain unbuilt.

nodes.label: Scientific identity and application ownership boundary
nodes.rationale: DAPPER represents scientific objects; application envelopes represent users, jobs, rankings, selections and aliases. Digest deduplication never grants access.

nodes.label: Pinned DAPPER research-agent runtime
nodes.rationale: Every attempt clones and verifies DAPPER 0.2.0-a1; historical input pins are allowed explicitly without rewriting old objects. Box/Claude/MCP isolation remains worker integration work.

nodes.label: Trusted scientific account acceptance
nodes.rationale: Backend supplies true actors/runtime, resolves IDs and reruns final lint. Additional grounding, ownership and scientific-faithfulness gates precede atomic persistence.

nodes.label: Automatic cited-Paragraph outbox
nodes.rationale: Each accepted account transactionally queues a separate paragraph job, deduplicated by payload observation and citation/skill pins. Paragraph failure leaves accepted accounts usable.

nodes.label: Versioned citation registry
nodes.rationale: Metadata revisions live outside the target digest; fixed pins and code-point spans prevent bibliography drift. Rendered formatting does not change scientific identity.

nodes.label: Durable job lifecycle
nodes.rationale: MySQL queue uses attempts, leases, heartbeat and execution IDs; reconcile Box before restarting paid work and guard against stale terminal writes.

nodes.label: DAPPER payload observations
nodes.rationale: Digest identity and exact payload identity differ. Permitted unhashable changes append payload hashes rather than overwriting records used by earlier claims.

nodes.label: Owned gap/account dashboard
nodes.rationale: Two dashboard tabs project immutable request/job history. Anonymous possession and registered identity are distinct from historical scientific authorship.

nodes.label: DisMech source-specific database import
nodes.rationale: Loads paired exports without minting DAPPER identities or embeddings. Full JSON source payloads coexist with indexed navigation projections.

nodes.label: Paired DisMech snapshot validation
nodes.rationale: Both manifests require matching commit and source-file inventories; validate checksums, counts, gap subsets and complete attachment coverage before database access.

nodes.label: DisMech gap attachment preservation
nodes.rationale: Preserve source status, unresolved and ambiguous references, whole sections/documents and non-mechanism targets without inventing relations.

nodes.label: Resumable DisMech imports
nodes.rationale: Transactionally commit rows/checkpoints under an import-scoped advisory lock, verify all old rows on replay, and retain changed snapshots under new import IDs.

nodes.label: Prepared DisMech tables (not loaded into Aurora)
nodes.rationale: Offline and disposable MySQL validation passed; this guide explicitly states production import has not occurred.

nodes.label: Legacy 711-trait EAGGL atlas
nodes.rationale: The loaded source has 4,037 factors and capped weights; source IDs are not automatically CFDE aliases and semantic proximity is not biological equivalence.

nodes.label: EAGGL factor label embeddings
nodes.rationale: 3,103 unique labels share reusable 768-dimensional BioBERT vectors; run identity separates source, endpoint, provider, model/revision and template.

nodes.label: Database-backed cosine search index
nodes.rationale: Load a reusable index from complete MySQL imports/runs; retrieve exact trait-filtered factor matches with measured cosine and import/run provenance.

nodes.label: Capped factor-gene weights
nodes.rationale: Omitted rows mean zero only within a complete factor/gene axis; absent genes are outside source scope. Cap audits remain frozen artifacts.

nodes.label: EAGGL parent-to-child hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Preserves loading-derived group summaries and hierarchy independently from factor-label embeddings and without a new full group-by-gene matrix.

nodes.label: Separate source and embedding completion
nodes.rationale: Source load can remain complete after vector loading failure; unavailable embedding runs must not be searched.

nodes.label: Exact trait + factor-number routing
nodes.rationale: Application routing deliberately ignores labels, genes and loading agreement. 1,756 source factors map; 2,281 unmatched factors retain explicit reasons.

nodes.label: Pinned completed mapping run
nodes.rationale: Pin source/catalog/GeneSet imports and resolved IDs to drafts and requests. New completed runs affect new drafts without rewriting historical jobs.

nodes.label: CFDE native-ID lookup
nodes.rationale: lookup_factor returns matched/unmatched status, full current CFDE node ID, original display label and nullable GeneSet links. A missing summary link does not block a factor.

nodes.label: Ranked CFDE GeneSet summary links
nodes.rationale: 4,056 of 8,780 ranked top_gene_sets references resolve to existing DAPPER objects; unresolved keys stay nullable. Rank is neither loading nor confidence.

nodes.label: Atomic crosswalk load
nodes.rationale: Migration 004 depends on GeneSet/EAGGL migrations 001/002 and is independent of pending DisMech 003; rows commit atomically under an advisory lock.

nodes.label: Evidence collector
nodes.rationale: Resolve an exact DisMech gap and 1–10 full native CFDE factor IDs; save every captured source for replay. Does not create claims, query Proto-OKN or launch Box.

nodes.label: Eleven-request single-factor capture
nodes.rationale: Catalog and factor verification plus four same-seed expansions, contextual edges, and factor/phenotype BioIndex queries require 11 successful requests for one trait/factor.

nodes.label: Pure deterministic evidence builder
nodes.rationale: Identical frozen inputs, policy and code yield identical bytes/hashes. It supplies no time, random IDs, embeddings or generated prose.

nodes.label: Pinned GeneSet alias hydration
nodes.rationale: Resolve exact aliases through a checksummed completed import and reuse DAPPER objects/activity. Unknown retained aliases fail rather than producing invented GeneSets.

nodes.label: Input capture versus dispatch readiness
nodes.rationale: input_capture_complete proves capture completeness; trusted worker ownership/attribution, tokenizer and cost/tool gates remain distinct.

nodes.label: Deterministic retained graph
nodes.rationale: Rank aggregate score descending/full ID ascending, retain all seeds, bound edges and record omissions; repeated identical edges merge locators and conflicts fail.

nodes.label: Portable offline replay
nodes.rationale: Relative source-root bindings, dependency and source hashes permit relocation with identical bytes; changed builder code fails and requires a new assembly.

nodes.label: Immutable evidence package 0.2-draft
nodes.rationale: Freezes selected gap, mechanisms and exact source observations before research. Historical 0.1 fixtures remain illustrative and nondispatchable.

nodes.label: Field-aware CURIE resolution
nodes.rationale: Expand only declared CURIE fields using pinned PrefixResolver/transform_identifiers. Native DisMech aliases and result/artifact IDs remain opaque; no rewriting imported identity.

nodes.label: Distinct loading, association and similarity quantities
nodes.rationale: Mechanism factor_value, gene-trait statistics, set-trait beta values, graph rank and embedding cosine carry different meanings and must not collapse into one score.

nodes.label: Overlapping source observation accounting
nodes.rationale: Different endpoint projections and repeated contextual edges are not independent corroboration. Preserve exact source refs, precision and revision.

nodes.label: Semantic suggestion provenance
nodes.rationale: Computed matches retain measured cosine, input/template/model/run hashes and contributing ranks; illustrative co-selection is not measured similarity or equivalence.

nodes.label: GeneSet membership and construction provenance
nodes.rationale: Catalog GeneSet identities lack membership and source-assay history; verified enrichment can follow GeneSetCollection/File/Activity relationships without attaching unrelated HuBMAP evidence.

nodes.label: Evidence observations to biological propositions
nodes.rationale: A Claim assesses one Proposition; one EvidenceItem has one target. Reuse artifacts across distinct evidence uses and avoid redundant observation Claims unless independently useful.

nodes.label: Append-only Proto-OKN enrichment ledger
nodes.rationale: Only selected BiomarkerKG/ProKN graphs; retain every request/result including failures/no matches, exact locators and hashes without mutating initial inputs.

nodes.label: CFDE ancestry for account findings
nodes.rationale: Every account finding must trace to captured CFDE evidence. Auxiliary KG source Claims are distinct; no-match is not support or biological absence.

nodes.label: Historical legacy EAGGL evidence fragment
nodes.rationale: Version 0.1-draft, dispatch_ready=false, source-local namespace, current CFDE mapping not established inside this frozen fixture. Later crosswalk work does not rewrite it.

nodes.label: Legacy CAD Factor1: Lipoprotein Metabolism and Clearance
nodes.rationale: Source mechanism with capped gene-loading observations; APOB original 1.216 is retained alongside capped 1.0. This is not a calibrated probability.

nodes.label: Legacy CAD Factor8: Vascular Development and Migration
nodes.rationale: Source mechanism retains top-gene annotations and actual capped values. Named top gene sets have no per-set loading in the metadata row.

nodes.label: Cap-at-one gene-loading transformation
nodes.rationale: Exact source artifact locators retain original and capped quantities for interpreting the legacy matrix.

nodes.label: Historical CAD evidence package fixture
nodes.rationale: Illustrative 0.1-draft capture, dispatch_ready=false. Retains three genes/two sets from eight/eight; no measured semantic match, KG assertion or set membership.

nodes.label: CAD PGS×context reverse-causation knowledge gap
nodes.rationale: Selected source gap asks whether exposures amplify genetic risk or contexts are downstream readouts. CAD scope is broader than the CAD-in-T2D mechanism fit.

nodes.label: CAD-in-T2D cfde-inc-v2 Factor1
nodes.rationale: Native current-model mechanism selected manually for this design example; co-selection is not semantic correspondence to a legacy CAD factor.

nodes.label: CAD illustrative observation coverage
nodes.rationale: 17 nodes/16 captured edges become six nodes/five retained edges. Factor-target query was not captured; neither absent results nor bounded counts prove biological absence.

nodes.label: Trusted Next.js-to-EC2 identity gateway
nodes.rationale: Next.js owns browser sessions; EC2 validates short-lived signed assertions and authorizes durable application principals. Contract exists; service remains unimplemented.

nodes.label: Server-provisioned anonymous principal
nodes.rationale: Anonymous writes require trusted first-party session, CSRF and idempotency. Caller-supplied UUID/flag/email/ORCID is never proof of ownership.

nodes.label: Verified issuer/subject identity mapping
nodes.rationale: Fresh provider proof resolves to stable application UUID; never automatically merge by email and never send provider tokens to scientific API.

nodes.label: Atomic anonymous workspace claim
nodes.rationale: New login can upgrade the same UUID; transfer to an existing account requires both source and fresh target proofs plus explicit consent. Retire source credentials and preserve scientific authorship.

nodes.label: Private ownership versus scientific authorship
nodes.rationale: Internal UUIDs own research but scientific actor identifiers and citation bylines remain separate, including after workspace transfer.

nodes.label: EPKeyedRecord
nodes.description: A dictionary entry. _key is carried by the enclosing JSON/YAML map and need not be repeated inside its value.

nodes.label: EPPrefix
nodes.description: A declared CURIE prefix and expansion; serializes as a simple prefix-to-URI dictionary.

nodes.label: EPSelectionOrigin
nodes.description: Selection origin keyed by full mechanism ID; serializes as a simple string dictionary.

nodes.label: EPSourceRef
nodes.description: Location of an observation in one frozen source artifact.

nodes.label: EPBuilderPin
nodes.description: Version and exact source-code hash of the deterministic assembly implementation.

nodes.label: EPDapperPin
nodes.description: Pinned DAPPER schema and identity implementation dependency manifest.

nodes.label: EPIdentifierPolicy
nodes.description: Rules for interpreting record aliases and preserving minted DAPPER objects.

nodes.label: EPExpansionPolicy
nodes.description: One direct expansion round from the original selected mechanisms.

nodes.label: EPSemanticRetrieval
nodes.description: Semantic selection metadata; uncomputed scores must not be invented.

nodes.label: EPSelection
nodes.description: The exact gap and anchor set submitted by the caller.

nodes.label: EPSourceRevision
nodes.description: Frozen DisMech source revision and selected document checksum.

nodes.label: EPRepositoryOrigin
nodes.description: Repository location of a frozen source document.

nodes.label: EPSourceArtifact
nodes.description: Content-addressed source artifact with a durable DAPPER File identity. Transport input paths are not part of this descriptor.

nodes.label: EPRawObject
nodes.description: Opaque upstream JSON object. Fields are preserved, not reinterpreted or validated as DAPPER. Only explicitly identified source boundaries are open.

nodes.label: EPJSONValue
nodes.description: Any JSON value, used only as the base range of explicitly constrained source unions.

nodes.label: EPAttachment
nodes.description: An indexed DisMech attachment, including unresolved outcomes.

nodes.label: EPKnowledgeGapContext
nodes.description: Selected natural-language gap with its original DisMech context and exact DAPPER binding.

nodes.label: EPSemanticAssociation
nodes.description: Retrieval association only; semantic similarity does not constitute biological evidence.

nodes.label: EPDismechMechanism
nodes.description: Raw DisMech pathophysiology record plus typed application bindings. Additional curated source fields are intentionally preserved.

nodes.label: EPAttachedContext
nodes.description: A linked non-mechanism DisMech item or entire section/document.

nodes.label: EPRawList
nodes.description: Opaque upstream array for a whole-section attachment. Its members remain source data.

nodes.label: EPRelatedGap
nodes.description: A related same-document gap that cannot replace the selected question.

nodes.label: EPRelatedGaps
nodes.description: Bounded related knowledge-gap context.

nodes.label: EPDismechContext
nodes.description: The selected gap, linked mechanisms and other curated source context.

nodes.label: EPFit
nodes.description: Exact PIGEAN/EAGGL trait-specific fit. A factor is a mechanism in this application.

nodes.label: EPInteractiveObservation
nodes.description: Interactive direct-edge measurements, with metric names and numeric precision preserved.

nodes.label: EPLoadingObservation
nodes.description: One entity-to-mechanism relationship, optionally enriched with its BioIndex loading. Scores are not causal probabilities.

nodes.label: EPLoadingCollection
nodes.description: Retained relationships plus the overall typed-query outcome, distinguishing empty from missing.

nodes.label: EPMechanismEvidence
nodes.description: A selected EAGGL mechanism, exact fit and gene/gene-set/trait observations.

nodes.label: EPReportedMetrics
nodes.description: Named PIGEAN metrics preserved without a shared confidence transformation.

nodes.label: EPTraitObservation
nodes.description: A source occurrence from a factor or phenotype query. Duplicate occurrences are not independent corroboration.

nodes.label: EPTraitEntityObservations
nodes.description: All retained source occurrences for one gene or gene set within this trait.

nodes.label: EPTraitAssociations
nodes.description: Retained trait observations, keyed by full source entity ID.

nodes.label: EPTraitEvidence
nodes.description: Trait-level associations retain both factor-query and dedicated phenotype-query occurrences.

nodes.label: EPGraphNode
nodes.description: Native interactive graph node metadata.

nodes.label: EPGraphEdge
nodes.description: Captured interactive edge, retaining native identity, scores and optional upstream metadata. A path does not itself establish membership or causality.

nodes.label: EPRetainedEdge
nodes.description: Deduplicated edge with every captured source occurrence.

nodes.label: EPSupportingPath
nodes.description: Native interactive path metadata used to rank a candidate; not a new DAPPER evidence-item class.

nodes.label: EPInteractiveCandidate
nodes.description: Candidate and ranking statistics as returned by the interactive API.

nodes.label: EPCandidateEvidence
nodes.description: Retained candidate, native record and exact source locator.

nodes.label: EPGraph
nodes.description: Bounded retained graph. Endpoint closure and duplicate edge IDs are verified by the builder.

nodes.label: EPContextualRelationships
nodes.description: Outcome of the single contextual-edges query, including deduplication counts.

nodes.label: EPPigeanEvidence
nodes.description: Mechanism and trait observations from the selected CFDE model, with a bounded graph.

nodes.label: EPGeneBinding
nodes.description: Source-local gene symbol; no external gene identity mapping is inferred.

nodes.label: EPGeneSetBinding
nodes.description: Exact imported DAPPER GeneSet identity; catalog presence does not verify membership or original construction provenance.

nodes.label: EPEntities
nodes.description: Entity-to-DAPPER or source-local identity bindings.

nodes.label: EPQueryOutcomes
nodes.description: All four typed expansion outcomes and the contextual query outcome.

nodes.label: EPBioIndexProgress
nodes.description: Upstream byte progress; continuation null is not evidence of exhaustive coverage.

nodes.label: EPBioIndexCoverage
nodes.description: One bounded BioIndex source query.

nodes.label: EPCoverage
nodes.description: Captured/retained graph counts and explicit omissions. No common upstream build or exhaustive retrieval is assumed.

nodes.label: EPBuildPolicy
nodes.description: Deterministic retention limits. A byte limit does not replace the agent-model tokenizer budget.

nodes.label: EPInstruction
nodes.description: Exact frozen authoring instruction artifact.

nodes.label: EPAuthoring
nodes.description: Frozen skill and scientific contracts, with the exact selected question required for each authored account.

nodes.label: EPExternalEvidence
nodes.description: Initial enrichment configuration. Queries and assertions are added to a later append-only ledger, never this frozen package.

nodes.label: EPReadiness
nodes.description: Capture validity and remaining worker checks; capture completeness is not dispatch authorization.

nodes.label: EPDapperContext
nodes.description: Trusted hydrated DAPPER objects. Imported classes are reused from the pinned snapshot, not redefined. Identity digests and dependency closure require the DAPPER validator.

nodes.label: EvidencePackage
nodes.description: Frozen application input for the scientific-account agent. Stable application sections are closed; only raw source boundaries are extensible.

nodes.label: EPQueryStatus
nodes.description: Availability of a bounded query or retained collection. Empty does not imply biological absence.

nodes.label: EPSimilarityStatus
nodes.description: Whether semantic similarity was actually measured.

nodes.label: EPNodeType
nodes.description: Supported interactive graph entity types.

nodes.label: EPArtifactFormat
nodes.description: Serialization of the exact source bytes.

nodes.label: EPAttachmentResolution
nodes.description: DisMech attachment lookup outcome.

nodes.label: EPGapKind
nodes.description: Kinds accepted by the gap collector.

nodes.label: EPNotQueried
nodes.description: Initial packages have no external enrichment results.

nodes.label: EPProvidedSubset
nodes.description: Related questions are a bounded supplied subset.

nodes.label: EPSha256
nodes.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 or binary bytes.

nodes.label: EPSourcePointer
nodes.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into a saved structured artifact; empty string selects the root.

nodes.label: EPFactorID
nodes.description: Full CFDE interactive mechanism identity including trait group, phenotype, model and factor.

nodes.label: Selected-gap account framing
nodes.rationale: Every account retains the exact selected KnowledgeGap; research subqueries and related gaps cannot replace the original inquiry.

nodes.label: Closing synthesis
nodes.rationale: Closing remarks explain how scoped assessments jointly address the gap. New substantive conclusions require assessed Claims; the account has no aggregate truth value or confidence.

nodes.label: Target-specific evidence reuse
nodes.rationale: One EvidenceItem targets one Proposition. Shared source Files/Claims can inform separate EvidenceItems for different targets; reuse is not independent corroboration.

nodes.label: EAGGL factor is a mechanism
nodes.rationale: Full EAGGL factor identity directly identifies the mechanism. Interim labels such as Factor1 do not require an extra equivalence assessment.

nodes.label: Gene → mechanism involvement template
nodes.rationale: Gene factor_value informs scoped biological involvement; loading is not a probability or signed regulatory effect.

nodes.label: Gene-set → mechanism involvement template
nodes.rationale: Loading and verified set definition/provenance support program interpretation without asserting every member role or a validated readout.

nodes.label: Gene → trait involvement template
nodes.rationale: combined/log_bf/prior retain original method-specific meanings and scope; no invented probability transformation.

nodes.label: Gene-set → trait involvement template
nodes.rationale: beta and beta_uncorrected remain separately named effects interpreted with the gene program definition.

nodes.label: factor_value loading
nodes.rationale: Mechanism loading is distinct from trait relevance, normalized retrieval and biological confidence.

nodes.label: combined, log_bf and prior
nodes.rationale: Gene-trait relevance quantities retain their source meanings without invented transformations.

nodes.label: beta and beta_uncorrected
nodes.rationale: Distinct gene-set trait effect estimates retain separate metric identities.

nodes.label: Interactive normalized_score
nodes.rationale: Ranking normalization is not a biological probability; captures do not establish its formula.

nodes.label: Optional source-Claim pattern
nodes.rationale: Separate RESULT Claims and typed ClaimScores are useful for durable citation or independent assessment, but not required wrappers for every observation.

nodes.label: Biological direction versus evidence direction
nodes.rationale: Inhibition/amplification is Proposition content; supporting an inhibition Proposition uses SUPPORTS. Loading signs and up/dn labels do not establish regulatory roles.

nodes.label: Withdrawn graph-path EvidenceItem extension
nodes.rationale: The graph-path proposal was withdrawn; existing DAPPER Claim, Proposition, ClaimScore, EvidenceItem and ScientificAccount fields are used.

nodes.label: Exact selected-gap invariant
nodes.rationale: ScientificAccount.question equals the frozen selected gap ID and preserves its payload. Generic Question-framed structural validity does not establish scenario relevance.

nodes.label: CAD account fixture
nodes.rationale: Current HTML/OpenAPI uses the imported cad_pgsxc_reverse_causation gap, 12 biological Claims and 16 direct artifact EvidenceItems; KG/membership assertions are explicitly illustrative.

nodes.label: DAPPER 0.2.0-a1
nodes.rationale: Each fresh agent start verifies release tag, commit and checksums. Known historical v8 inputs are approved explicitly without reminting; unknown snapshots stop startup.

nodes.label: Pinned agent startup
nodes.rationale: Fresh workspaces, immutable release locks and checked artifacts make attempts reproducible. Read-only Box mounts remain a worker responsibility.

nodes.label: Independent final validation
nodes.rationale: Backend final lint uses trusted code, lock and frozen inputs on returned document bytes, never agent-supplied reports. A fresh interpreter avoids importing an older collector snapshot.

nodes.label: Scientific acceptance gates
nodes.rationale: Structural validity does not prove support: exact metrics/locators, attribution, external ledger enforcement and synthesis review remain separate acceptance gates.

nodes.label: CFDE GeneSet catalog import
nodes.rationale: Catalog-only records provide durable exact model/key aliases and encoding provenance; membership and original construction history remain not_loaded.

nodes.label: Immutable DAPPER GeneSet identity
nodes.rationale: Hashable enrichment creates new digests and mapping revisions while historical citations retain original objects. Catalog encoding is not scientific creation.

nodes.label: Completed-import alias resolution
nodes.rationale: Resolve model, exact case-sensitive node_id and a chosen complete import to DAPPER IDs; missing aliases remain explicit without fabricated or similar-name substitutions.

nodes.label: Resumable GeneSet import
nodes.rationale: Commit rows and progress transactionally, verify checksums/completeness and replay without duplicates or overwriting conflicting content.

nodes.label: CFDE interactive catalog GET /api/interactive/catalog
nodes.rationale: Returned node IDs are opaque identities; probes do not establish full enumeration or semantic search.

nodes.label: CFDE direct connections POST /api/interactive/connections
nodes.rationale: One direct expansion round uses original anchors with mean reducer and empty context. Response graph fragments omit anchors, which must be merged before endpoint validation.

nodes.label: CFDE contextual edges POST /api/interactive/contextual-edges
nodes.rationale: Deduplicate relationships among supplied nodes while retaining query provenance; repeated contextual edges are not independent evidence.

nodes.label: Bounded query coverage
nodes.rationale: candidate_count is returned length, not proven pre-limit total. At-limit responses may be clipped; empty does not imply biological absence.

nodes.label: Closed application sections and open source boundaries
nodes.rationale: Typed application fields reject unknowns while designated raw DisMech/JSON boundaries retain source fields and arrays without claiming schema ownership.

nodes.label: Schema and builder validation
nodes.rationale: Shape checks cover types, prefixes, DAPPER identities and closure. Builder checks separately establish pointer/checksum/projection agreement, graph consistency and coverage.

nodes.label: SQL migration authority
nodes.rationale: Reviewed SQL remains authoritative for collations, CHECK constraints and ON UPDATE timestamps that Prisma cannot fully represent; Aurora has no baselined Prisma migration history.

nodes.label: Prisma applied and pending tables
nodes.rationale: 23 models cover 14 applied Aurora tables plus nine pending DisMech tables. Schema presence does not imply deployment.

nodes.label: Embedding service contract
nodes.rationale: POST /embed yields float32 rows in input order; validate counts, dimensions, finiteness and batch consistency. Per-attempt timeout does not replace job budgets.

nodes.label: EAGGL → CFDE routing crosswalk
nodes.rationale: Exact trait and factor-number routing preserves gene/label differences. lookup_factor returns native CFDE identity and ranked GeneSet references with resolved DAPPER IDs.

nodes.label: Mapped candidate retrieval
nodes.rationale: Filter mapped candidates before top-five cutoff, deduplicate native CFDE IDs and freeze source/embedding/mapping runs for request replay; mapping switches affect new drafts only.

nodes.label: Job attempts, outbox and leases
nodes.rationale: Durable claims, leases and terminal guards prevent duplicate paid Box launches and stale attempts replacing accepted or cancelled results.

nodes.label: Post-acceptance Paragraph generation
nodes.rationale: Acceptance queues a unique outbox job pinned to account/citation revisions; paragraph failure leaves conclusions available and paragraph generation does not query KGs.

nodes.label: construct-scientific-account skill
nodes.rationale: Worker supplies exact gap, frozen inputs, trusted runtime and permitted read-only evidence tools. Agent authors the smallest useful scoped account or explicit insufficiency.

nodes.label: Append-only tool evidence ledger
nodes.rationale: Every attempted call captures request/result artifacts and locators, including errors and empties. Stop retrieval without complete capture or graph enforcement; frozen input remains unchanged.

hyperedges.label: Selected-gap research and automatic expression flow
Trusted input → per-account output → final acceptance boundary
Reproducible scientific identity, citation metadata and rendered expression
Initial retrieval: embedded source labels, versioned route, native collector inputs
Frozen observations and append-only enrichment feed proposition assessments
Verified identity and anonymous ownership converge through workspace claim while preserving authorship
Pinned startup and independently validated scientific-account output
EAGGL search to native CFDE anchor and DAPPER GeneSet routing
